Name: Active and Useful Pets
Author: justrecht
Description:
[color=#f1c232][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Active and Useful Pets![/b][/font][/size][/color]

[font=Comic Sans MS]Turn your pets from simple farm followers into [b]active, helpful companions[/b] that grow, explore, and support you throughout your Stardew Valley journey.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
With [b]Active and Useful Pets[/b], your pets can gain levels, unlock abilities, explore the valley, protect your crops, assist in combat, and develop unique personalities based on how you care for them.[/font]
[line]
[heading][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Features[/font][/color][/heading]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]📈 Pet Leveling System[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Your pets now gain XP over time and can level up to [b]Level 20[/b].
Pets gain XP from:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b]+5 XP daily base[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b]+10 XP from petting[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b]+5 XP bonus at max friendship[/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]As your pet levels up, new abilities are unlocked, making them more useful around the farm and beyond.[/font]
[line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]🎯 Progressive Pet Abilities[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]As your pet grows, they unlock helpful abilities:[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Scavenger[/size]
Pets can find seasonal forage items while exploring the valley.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Watchdog[/size]
Pets have a [b]100% chance to scare away crows at night[/b], helping protect your crops.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Companion[/size]
Enable [b]Follow Mode[/b] and have your pet accompany you outside the farm.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Combat [size=4]Support[/size][/size]
When following you in dangerous areas, pets can attack nearby monsters and assist in combat.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Lucky[/size]
Your pet can grant you a luck effect to help improve your day.[/font]
[line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]🐾 Pet Exploration[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Pets are no longer stuck around the farmhouse all day.
During the day, pets can autonomously explore different locations across the valley, including:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Town[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Beach[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Forest[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Mountains[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]In the evening, they return home with any items they found during exploration.
Exploration behavior is dynamic and can be affected by your pet’s personality traits.[/font]
[line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]🧠 Personality System[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Each pet can develop a unique personality based on your daily care and interactions.
Possible personality traits include:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Energetic[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Playful[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Affectionate[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Curious[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Lazy[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Grumpy[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Sleepy[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Your pet’s personality can evolve over time and affects how often they explore, how they behave, and what kind of mood messages you receive.
Daily personality messages help you understand your pet’s current mood and behavior.[/font]
[line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]📊 Pet Status Menu[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]A dedicated [b]Pet Status Menu[/b] lets you track all your pets in one place.
Default hotkey: [b]P[/b]
From this menu, you can view:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Pet level[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]XP progress[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Friendship level[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Unlocked abilities[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Active personality traits[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Current exploration status[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Current location[/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]⚙️ Configuration[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]This mod includes support for [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
With GMCM, you can easily configure:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Key bindings[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Personality messages[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Scavenging ability[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Crow protection[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Combat support[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Other pet-related features[/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]📋 Installation & Requirements[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Required[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Recommended[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]
Used for easier in-game configuration.[/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]ℹ️ Important Notes[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Harmony Patches[/size]
SMAPI may show a warning that this mod patches game code using Harmony. This is normal and expected.
Harmony is required so the mod can properly integrate pet abilities into Stardew Valley’s game logic.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Save Compatibility[/size]
This mod is safe to add to existing saves.
Pet data is saved per save file and will persist across sessions.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Solo Project[/size]
This mod is developed and maintained by one person as a passion project.
I will continue improving and updating it, but bugs may occasionally happen. Thank you for your patience and support.[/font]
[line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]🐛 Support & Feedback[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Found a bug?
Please report it in the [b]Bugs[/b] or [b]Posts[/b] tab and include your SMAPI log:
[url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url]
This helps make troubleshooting much easier.[/font]
[line]
[heading][font=Comic Sans MS]💝 Support the Mod[/font][/heading]
[font=Comic Sans MS]If you enjoy [b]Active and Useful Pets[/b], please consider supporting the project by:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Endorsing the mod on Nexus Mods[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Sharing it with other Stardew Valley players[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Supporting me via PayPal[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]Your support helps keep this project alive and encourages future updates.[/font]
[line]
